npcRoster.name: Dr. Allia Fillmore
npcRoster.publicDescription: Dr. Allia Fillmore is a Dwarf chief engineer who believes every grand ideology eventually becomes a maintenance problem with screaming civilians attached. She keeps Glasswell Institute power systems, transit engines, and ichor-processing conduits functioning through stubborn craft, ruthless prioritization, and a terrifying memory for who ignored her warnings. Allia is loyal to infrastructure before leadership, which makes her invaluable when the machine works and dangerous when she decides the machine should not.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Elarithen is a Capital City in Aelwynora, under Consensus Democracy, with high danger, Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Farming terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Dwarf reads through the Dwarf entry of the race compendium, within Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, marked by Marduthor. Dwarves are stout, resilient folk deeply tied to stone, craft, and ancestral tradition. They value honor, craftsmanship, and enduring legacies over fleeting trends. Table cues: Darkvision, Dwarven Resilience, Dwarven Toughness, Stonecunning; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
publicRumors: Allia has a sealed list of every Directorate project she considers structurally doomed.
When she says an ichor valve is 'temperamental,' veterans leave the district.

npcRoster.name: Travis Lonelybell
npcRoster.publicDescription: Travis Lonelybell is a Luma radio host whose voice starts every broadcast as a nervous apology and somehow still reaches people who need to feel less alone. They/he reports market news, lost persons, public warnings, strange songs, and Brass Concordat notices while fighting the conviction that everyone else would do the job better. With support, Travis can become funny, brave, and startlingly steady; without it, they/he hides behind dead air and self-mockery.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Sylvathûn is a Town in Aelwynora, under Consensus Democracy, with moderate danger, Hybrid tree and forest floor, Beach and grass with water, Partial forest terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train, Ferry, Steamship. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Luma reads through the Feathren entry of the race compendium, within Birdfolk and Avian Races, marked by Sokhivar. Lightweight avian humanoids with iridescent plumage and cultural diversity, Feathren are expressive and artistic. They value beauty, movement, and social bonds. Table cues: Darkvision, Feathren Ancestry, Kindred Speech, Natural Creator; starting tendency Altruistic - Neutral - Cooperative - Honorable.
publicRumors: Travis practices emergency announcements under a blanket so no one hears them panic first.
Their most awkward broadcast once prevented a caravan from taking a bridge that collapsed an hour later.

npcRoster.publicDescription: Dr. Justen Ayo is a hard-shelled Tortle bureau chief who treats empathy as a security flaw and fugitives as misplaced inventory. He oversees Glasswell Institute retrieval files, memory compliance, and internal suspicion with patient cruelty, preferring paperwork that makes violence look like procedure. Justen is not reckless; he is methodical, vindictive, and convinced that the world is safer when people are too afraid to run.

Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Tortle reads through the Tortle entry of the race compendium, within Draconic and Reptilian Races, marked by Valkhamesh. Shelled, turtle-like humanoids who carry their homes and traditions upon their backs. They are calm, patient, and deeply tied to cycles of land and sea. Table cues: Claws, Hold Breath, Natural Armor, Nature's Intuition; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.

npcRoster.name: Larionie Horrin
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Larionie Horrin is a brilliant, flirtatious, dangerous Half-Orc inventor whose charm can feel like a performance until her grief, guilt, and impossible intelligence cut through the mask. She dislikes crude violence but loves elegant solutions, so her weapons stock favors thundercoil stunners, grappler rigs, restraint devices, archive-safe explosives, and ichor-reactive tools designed to disable, contain, or outthink a threat rather than simply butcher it.
At the Yltharien Archive, Larionie works through the Brass Concordat as a specialist merchant for relic-hunters, caravan guards, and investigators who need equipment that can survive cursed ruins, divine residue, and black-market ichor contamination. She is seductive, calculating, remorseful, and capable of long, devastating plans, but she is also someone desperately trying to prove that invention can still save lives after once using genius to nearly destroy her own.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Yltharien is a City in Aelwynora, under Consensus Democracy, with high danger, Beach and grass with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Half-Orc reads through the Human entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Orc (Human + Orc Lineage). Humans are highly adaptable and found in nearly every environment across the world. They are known for their cultural diversity, short generational cycles, and unmatched versatility among mortal races. Table cues: Resourceful, Skillful, Versatile; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Neutral.

sourcePolicy.preserveOriginalProvinceRecords: The 29 overlapping province/distance JSON files were byte-identical between the geography-distance package and the province-area package, so the canonical records are retained and expanded in-place.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.

provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Aelwynora is centered at 61.114097, -25.982066 under Consensus Democracy, with 47,825,000 people across 11 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Aelwynora occupies 5,226,112.83 sq mi / 13,535,570.09 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.653691% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest and Ocean Surface floating settlement define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement, Farming, Hybrid tree and forest floor and Beach and reefs with water. Population density is 3.533 people/sq km / 9.151 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
